content_html:
Ready-to-use prompts and agent setups for trading with AI through TraderWAI, a hosted MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Cursor read live charts, run backtests on 1-minute history and work with your own broker account (MetaTrader 4/5, cTrader, TradeLocker, Match-Trader, DXtrade, Capital.com, tastytrade, Binance, Bybit).

Copy a recipe, paste it into your AI, adjust the symbol and your risk. That's it.

Risk warning. Trading involves risk of loss. These recipes are examples, not investment advice. Past results, including backtests, don't guarantee future results. Start on a demo account.

Connect TraderWAI first

MCP server URL: https://mcp.traderwai.com (Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in, free plan available).

AI How
Cursor (editor) One-click install or add the server URL in Settings → MCP
Cursor cloud agents / Automations cursor.com/agents → MCP dropdown → add https://mcp.traderwai.com and sign in
Grok grok.com/connectors → New connector → Custom → paste the URL and sign in
Claude Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → paste the URL
ChatGPT Plugins → Add → Custom MCP server → paste the URL

Then link a broker account on traderwai.com/app (a demo account works). Analysis-only recipes work without a broker.

Recipes

Recipe Where it shines Needs a broker?
Hourly position watch Cursor Automation, every hour Yes
Break-even manager Any AI, set once Yes
Gold H1 review Any AI, or a scheduled agent No
London session brief Cursor Automation, weekdays 06:45 UTC No
Backtest an idea in plain English Any AI No
End-of-day journal Cursor Automation, weekdays 21:15 UTC Yes

Cursor rule

.cursor/rules/traderwai.mdc tells Cursor's agent how to use TraderWAI safely: check the broker price before any order, size from risk, propose instead of executing unless you say so, and always show the chart.

How the pieces fit

  • Your agent decides what to look at and when. A Cursor Automation can run a recipe on a schedule, even with your laptop closed.
  • TraderWAI does the market and broker work. Charts, exact candles, market structure, backtests and orders on your account, with server-side risk limits your agent cannot change.
  • Rules that must fire on time live on TraderWAI, not in the agent. Conditional orders (close, break-even, entry on a candle close) are checked every minute on our servers, so they don't depend on when your agent runs.
  • You stay in control. By default orders wait for your approval. Automatic execution is opt-in, per symbol, with daily caps.

Links

  • Website and free plan: traderwai.com
  • Docs: traderwai.com/en/docs
  • MCP server listing: github.com/leonardo-mazzitelli/traderwai-mcp
